relations: Fixed green veils and pink cloud undergo slow internal morphing and edge undulation rather than large translation.
Central hook-shaped strand and fine filaments gently undulate and diffuse their edges in place against the dark background.

Pinkish-white cloud in the lower-left shows faint local softening while maintaining its overall position.
caption: The video showcases a close view of translucent, filamentary wisps suspended against a dark, featureless background, reading as ink or smoke diffusing. Pale teal-green veils and curling tendrils dominate the center and right, a pinkish-white cloud fills the lower-left, and a thin reddish-orange streak runs near the right edge. The overall layout remains broadly fixed, with no large translation of the green column or the pink cloud. Instead, the fine filaments and the hook-shaped central strand undergo slow, gentle undulation, morphing their edges rather than moving across the scene. The green mass on the right subtly shifts its internal texture and outline in place, while the pinkish cloud shows only faint local softening. The reddish-orange streak persists in roughly the same location with only minor wavering. Motion appears continuous and slow, an ongoing diffusion already in progress with no visible onset or stop.
